blocks.text:
From 1 to 7 April 2027, this journey combines pilgrimage with the history of central Mexico. The itinerary includes five Holy Masses, the shrines of Guadalupe and Ocotlán, the Baroque churches of Puebla and Taxco, and the pyramids of Teotihuacán.

You return to Mexico City each evening. Spend all six nights in a standard room at Casa Blanca 4* or a similar hotel, with private transport and an English-speaking guide throughout the trip. Prices are available on request.
